Fine matte latex texture, clean manufactured edges, subtle natural surface variation, realistic soft highlights, no glossy plastic look.

Soft diffused studio lighting, delicate contact shadows, quiet warm neutral background without horizon line. Sharp professional commercial product photography, not illustration or toy-like CGI.
Constraints: ONLY five loop resistance bands. No dumbbells, stand, rack, pouch, packaging, handles, clips, anchors, people, hands, text, numbers, resistance labels, logos, branding, watermark, room setting or decorative props. Do not add a sixth band. Do not make open-ended straps or impossible intersecting rubber.
